label: Slack
description: Official Slack OAuth integration for workspace, channel, and messaging workflows.

apps.label: Slack
apps.description: Browse conversations, read and search messages, and post to Slack.

connectPrompt: Connect Slack to browse conversations, read and search messages, and post replies.

tools.name: slack_list_conversations
tools.description: List Slack channels, groups, IMs, or MPIMs visible to the connected user. When multiple Slack accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Slack account email or identifier.

tools.name: slack_get_conversation_history
tools.description: Read recent Slack conversation messages. When multiple Slack accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Slack account email or identifier.

tools.name: slack_post_message
tools.description: Post a Slack message to a channel or conversation. When multiple Slack accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

thread_ts.description: Optional parent message timestamp for a threaded reply.

account_email.description: Optional connected Slack account email or identifier.

tools.name: slack_search_messages
tools.description: Search Slack messages. When multiple Slack accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Slack account email or identifier.

tools.name: slack_get_user_info
tools.description: Get Slack user profile information. When multiple Slack accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

account_email.description: Optional connected Slack account email or identifier.

tools.name: slack_api_request
tools.description: Make an authenticated Slack Web API request for advanced Slack operations. When multiple Slack accounts are connected, set connection_id or account_email to choose which account to use.

method_name.description: Slack Web API method name, e.g. conversations.info.

account_email.description: Optional connected Slack account email or identifier.
